profile.description: Al Anwar Ceramic Tiles Company SAOG manufactures and sells glazed ceramic tiles in the Sultanate of Oman. The company offers floor, outdoor floor, wall, and elevated wall tiles, as well as decorative panels under the Al Shams brand name. It exports its products to approximately 20 countries in the Middle East and Africa. The company was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Muscat, the Sultanate of Oman.
